description: This file defines the ExternalAssetOwnerSearchService class, which provides a service for searching external asset owner data. It uses a repository for data fetching, a mapper for data transformation, and offers a method to perform searches with validation.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerSearchService
classes.description: A service class responsible for searching external asset owner data based on search requests, with dependencies injected for repository access and data mapping.

methods.name: searchInvestorData
methods.description: Performs a search for external asset owner data based on the provided paged request, validating the request and executing the search.

methods.name: validateTextSearchRequest
methods.description: Checks that the search request is not null, throwing an exception if it is.

methods.name: executeSearch
methods.description: Executes the search on the repository and maps results to ExternalTransferData.
